We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule (target) reproduces the forward reaction: aromatic amine attacks phenylsulfonyl chloride, forming sulfonamide, breaking S-Cl bond, forming N-S bond. So retrosynthetic step: break N-S bond to give aromatic amine and phenylsulfonyl chloride (or maybe phenylsulfonyl chloride plus amine). The target molecule is given: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

That's a sulfonamide: sulfonyl attached to N of an aniline (aryl amine) that is further substituted with a piperazine etc. Also sulfonyl attached to phenyl with F. So we need template that breaks N-S bond and forms S-Cl bond (i.e., reverse of forward). So functional groups formed: sulfonamide (N-S). Broken: S-Cl. So in forward reaction, sulfonamide formed, S-Cl broken. For retrosynthesis, we need template that breaks N-S bond and forms S-Cl bond. So we search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "sulfonamides"? Actually broken in forward = S-Cl, formed = sulfonamides. For retrosynthesis search, we specify functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonamides"]? Wait description: functional_groups_broken refers to forward reaction. So to get template that does forward formation of sulfonamide, we set functional_groups_formed = ["sulfonamides"], functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonyl chloride"? maybe "acyl chloride"? The functional group broken is "acyl chloride"? For sulfonyl chloride, functional group is "acyl chloride"? Not sure. The list includes "acyl chloride". That's for carbonyl. For sulfonyl chloride maybe "sulfonyl chloride"? Not in list. But we can also specify bonds broken: "S-Cl". So we can search with bonds_broken=["S-Cl"] and bonds_formed maybe "N-S". But bond format expects atomic numbers like "6-6". Not sure. Might be easier to search by functional groups: functional_groups_formed=["sulfonamides"], functional_groups_broken=["acyl chloride"]? Not perfect.

Let's try search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_formed=["sulfonamides"], bonds_broken maybe ["S-Cl"]? Not sure format. Let's try functional_groups_formed only.
